{"code":"import json,numpy as np
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import RBF,ConstantKernel,WhiteKernel
from scipy.stats import norm
D=json.load(open('evaluations.json'));names=[a['ingredient'] for a in D[0]['recipe']];X=np.array([[{a['ingredient']:a['fraction'] for a in d['recipe']}[n] for n in names] for d in D]);y=np.array([d['target_dissimilarity'] for d in D]);scale=np.array([.13,.08,.10,.08,.06,.025,.012,.008,.005]);g=GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=ConstantKernel(.04,(.001,1))*RBF(1,(.2,5))+WhiteKernel(.004,(.001,.02)),normalize_y=False,n_restarts_optimizer=10).fit(X/scale,y);print(g.kernel_)
rng=np.random.default_rng(42);c=X[4]+rng.normal(size=(40000,9))*scale*.3;c=np.maximum(c,.0005);c[:,0]=1-c[:,1:].sum(axis=1);c=c[c[:,0]>.2];mu,s=g.predict(c/scale,return_std=True);rank=np.argsort(mu-.7*s)
for i in rank[:5]:print(dict(zip(names,np.round(c[i],5))),mu[i],s[i])
np.save('candidate.npy',c[rank[0]])"}
